confusions: I had to go through the Questions list and scroll a long way down before I found the welfare, housing and generations section, and it was not obvious which link was which.
The welfare page was long and the 'without pensions' meaning was buried in the middle, so I only found out what it leaves out by reading the definitions bullet.
The welfare answer gave cash totals for 1955-56 and 2021-22 but not a multiple, so I had to work out the 'ten times' comparison myself.
The pensioner share of social security (54%) and the State Pension share of DWP spending (43.7%) are on different parts of the page, so I had to hunt for which one was which.
The house price page is twelve screens long and the mortgage rate answer sits right at the bottom, so I nearly missed it.
The figure for the over-75s owning their home was cut off at the bottom of a screen, so I had to scroll back to be sure I had the right number.
The state pension age was only in a summary paragraph (66 for 1960, 68 for 1978 onwards), and I did not find any detail on the wording used in the answer options.
The class size figures were in a table under a heading I had to scroll past several charts to reach, which took time I did not have.
